title: HomeKit Secure Video Activity Clip Gap
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homekit:securevideo
stats max(_time) as last_clip by camera_name
eval hours_since=(now()-last_clip)/3600
where hours_since>24
description: Alerts when HomeKit Secure Video stops uploading clips.
value: Surfacing homekit secure video activity clip gap helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant home security & surveillance export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back when homekit secure video activity clip gap matters for your routine.
